name: arm6-coupling-demo
title: Arm 6 — Cross-engine coupling demonstration
question: Can a single composite run part of the model in libroadrunner and part as a native process, sharing one store — a composition a monolithic SBML model structurally cannot express?
hypothesis: A hybrid composite (upper glycolysis in Tellurium, lower glycolysis native) sharing one species store runs through process-bigraph and reproduces the biological-seam result — demonstrating the composability payoff a monolith can never match.
objective: Demonstrate a cross-engine composition impossible for a monolith — the existence proof for the composability axis.
description: Methods arm of the SBML-decomposition investigation on Teusink glycolysis (BIOMD0000000064, 17 floating species). The model is authored as inline Antimony and shown in the Model tab. Arm 6 swaps arm 3's lower-glycolysis submodel for the native-pbg process while upper stays libroadrunner, both sharing one store. This is the composability existence proof; it has no monolithic reference (accuracy-exempt).
claim: A single composite runs HALF in libroadrunner and HALF native, sharing one store — structurally impossible for a monolith — and reproduces the biological-seam arm to 3.2e-7. This is the composability payoff, not a numeric result.

expected_behavior.name: arm6-cross-engine-composition-runs
expected_behavior.observable: a two-engine composite running through process-bigraph
expected_behavior.condition: builds, runs, emits the full 17-species set with finite output; accuracy-exempt (no monolithic reference)
expected_behavior.rationale: the value is the structural capability, demonstrated by a working cross-engine composite, not a trajectory match.

findings.summary: Hybrid composite: upper glycolysis (Tellurium SubmodelProcess) + lower glycolysis (NativeSubmodelProcess) share one species store, reconciling additively — a composition a single libroadrunner model cannot express.
Reproduces arm 3 (same ODEs, different engine) to max_rel_err 3.2e-7; the monolith-impossibility is STRUCTURAL, not numeric. Accuracy-exempt in the 3-way figure.
